props.gloss_en: 'and Hannah spoke in her heart' -- from here, one who prays must direct his heart
'and Hannah, she spoke in her heart' (I Sam 1:13)
'only her lips moved' -- from here, one who prays must articulate [the words] with his lips
'and her voice was not heard' -- from here, it is forbidden to raise one's voice in one's prayer
'and her voice was not heard' (I Sam 1:13)
'and Eli thought her drunk' -- from here, a drunk person is forbidden to pray
'and Eli thought her to be drunk' (I Sam 1:13)
from here, one who sees in his fellow an unseemly thing must rebuke him
'and Eli said to her: how long will you be drunk?' (I Sam 1:14)
'no, my lord': she said to him, you are not a master in this matter, nor does the holy spirit rest upon you, that you suspect me of this

thus she said to him: are you not a master? is the Shekhina and holy spirit not with you, that you judged me guilty and did not judge me innocent? did you not know that I am a woman of sorrowful spirit?
from here, one suspected of something that is not in him must inform [the suspecter]
'and wine and strong drink I have not drunk' (I Sam 1:15)
from here, a drunk who prays is as if he worships idols
from here, one who suspects his fellow of something that is not in him must appease him
'and Eli answered and said: go in peace' (I Sam 1:17)
and not only that, but he must bless him
as it is stated: 'and may the God of Israel grant your request' (I Sam 1:17)
